name: Block sensitive file access
description: Prevent reading or modifying sensitive files. Matchers match tool names only; the handler-level `if` field filters by path. Exit code 2 blocks the call and sends stderr to the model.

hooks.command: echo 'Blocked: Sensitive file access not allowed' >&2; exit 2
echo 'Blocked: Secrets directory is protected' >&2; exit 2
echo 'Blocked: Cannot modify environment files' >&2; exit 2
echo 'Blocked: Cannot modify environment files' >&2; exit 2
